course_name_original: Aparatos de Elevación, Transporte y Manutención
prerequisites: It is recommended that the student has taken the courses Theory of Mechanisms and Machines, Elasticity and Strength of Materials I and II, Graphic Expression and Assisted Design, Science and Engineering of Materials.
Foreign students must have a B1 level of Spanish to be able to follow the classes without difficulty.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to create the dynamic-mathematical model of simple mechanical transmissions.
Application of previous knowledge and that of the specific subject Machine Calculation in the realization of the preliminary design of a real machine.
Know the main diagnostic techniques in machinery control.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1.- Introduction to transport in industrial engineering.
1.3 Influence of transport on the economy
4.3 Dimensions of welded and rolled pulleys
5.2 Calculation, design, and dimensions of wheels
5.3 Calculation and fastenings of the rail
Topic 7. Occupational Risk Prevention in lifting devices. Periodic inspections
assessment_rules: The final grade is based entirely on a written exam.
